baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ and the result command فَقُلْ bind the response to the onset of their disputing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dispute is an interlaced verbal contest, while the answer is a single commanded utterance. The short knowledge formula therefore contains the exchange instead of supplying another strand for reciprocal argument.

activation_trace.role: The intertwined verbal contest supplies the recursive exchange that the response must contain.
The bringing-forth of speech supplies one bounded utterance as the alternative to continued contest.

changed_reading.before: Answer their argument with a counterargument.
changed_reading.after: When the contest begins, issue one bounded utterance that does not reproduce its verbal entanglement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The answer culminates in بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ rather than naming the proposition under dispute.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge as disclosure is directed toward intentional action. The reply relocates assessment from competing claims to the disputants' agency, allowing the act of disputing itself to fall within what is known.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic field in which conduct, not rhetoric alone, is exposed.
Intentional action makes the disputants' chosen conduct the object of divine knowing.

changed_reading.before: Allah knows which proposition in the dispute is correct.
changed_reading.after: Allah's knowledge encompasses what the disputants intentionally enact, including how they conduct the dispute.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَٰدَلُوكَ opens the condition and تَعْمَلُونَ closes the answer, placing verbal contest inside a wider field of operation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The work root can image putting speech or thought to use. That makes argument not merely a claim but an instrument the opponents are operating; the answer names the operator's practice without operating the same instrument back at them.

activation_trace.role: The looping contest supplies the verbal activity being redescribed as practiced work.
Putting speech or thought to work supplies an operational reading of the disputants' rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: What you do refers only to conduct outside the conversation.
changed_reading.after: What you do can include the way you employ and work language as a disputing instrument.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier repeated pattern joins disputing about Allah to being without knowledge; its second occurrence also removes guidance and an illuminating book. Against that pattern, the focus answer reverses the knowledge relation without presenting the addressee as a rival knower: it names Allah as the adequate knower and turns attention to the disputants' deeds.

activation_trace.role: The same interlaced contest appears earlier as argument conducted about Allah.
Knowledge as disclosure is explicitly absent from the earlier disputing, establishing the deficit reversed in the focus.
The repeated contest makes the focus condition the return of a surah-level verbal pattern rather than an isolated quarrel.
Gentle direction toward truth is named as another missing warrant, distinguishing guidance from argumentative force.
An established writing that entails judgment supplies the absent documentary warrant behind the earlier dispute.
The focus disclosure predicate answers the earlier deficit by relocating knowledge to Allah.

structural_cues: 22:3 and 22:8 repeat يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ before 22:68 returns to جَٰدَلُوكَ and ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ.
The focus answer changes the grammatical subject of knowing rather than supplying a longer body of counter-evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated dispute-without-knowledge formula and the focus knowledge formula; I infer a deliberate epistemic reversal and a refusal to claim equal human mastery. A live alternative is that the focus merely invokes generic omniscience without echoing the earlier formula.

changed_reading.before: The sentence is a generic appeal to omniscience used to end a quarrel.
changed_reading.after: It exposes the dispute's recurring knowledge deficit while declining to replace unsupported certainty with the speaker's own competing certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah supplies differentiated ritual practice, prohibits a two-sided pull over the matter, and positively commands invitation along straight guidance. The focus utterance is therefore an interactional hinge: it releases reciprocal contention while preserving directional speech toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Ritual as its place and enacted work supplies the concrete practical field over which contention arises.
Mutual pulling between two parties gives the prohibited dispute a bilateral force that the focus reply releases.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the non-coercive verbal mode that remains after reciprocal contention stops.
Gentle direction to a path and truth gives the continuing call its orientation rather than argumentative pressure.
Straightness and balance supply the stable route from which the addressee need not be pulled.
The commanded spoken sentence performs the transition from tugging exchange to bounded call.

structural_cues: 22:67 is the immediate antecedent and moves from assigned ritual, to prohibition of dispute, to command to call, to straight guidance.
22:68 begins conditionally: the brief reply is activated only if they continue the dispute.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted ritual, bilateral contention, a call, and straight guidance; I infer that the focus sentence changes the mode of speech from mutual pulling to directional invitation. A live alternative is that the adjacent commands are independent and imply no designed contrast of speech modes.

changed_reading.before: The command simply ends conversation with opponents.
changed_reading.after: It ends reciprocal contest but preserves invitation; differentiated enacted practices remain under divine knowledge rather than being verbally forced into sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts the focus knowledge claim into a jurisdictional sequence: people now take differing paths, while Allah judges between them on the resurrection day. The focus speaker's restraint is thus not uncertainty but refusal to preempt the named judge and time of judgment.

activation_trace.role: Divine disclosure supplies present knowledge without yet performing the subsequent public verdict.
Judgment between people supplies the reserved adjudicative act to which the dispute is transferred.
Each party taking a different road supplies the coexistence of unresolved divergence before judgment.

structural_cues: 22:69 immediately follows the commanded reply and repeats Allah as subject before naming future judgment.
The temporal phrase يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ separates present knowledge from final adjudication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent present knowledge, future judgment, and differing paths; I infer a transfer of jurisdiction and temporal deferral. A live alternative is that 22:69 promises judgment without explaining the rhetoric of 22:68.

changed_reading.before: Allah knows best immediately validates one side of the present exchange.
changed_reading.after: It names who has jurisdiction while withholding present human adjudication and leaving divergent paths for a future verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following expansion repeats knowing, extends its field to heaven and earth, and places that totality in a writing. Read back into بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ, deeds are not transient performances lost when speech ends; they are differentiable and registerable within comprehensive knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the conduct proposed as an item in the following comprehensive register.
Repeated disclosure to the knower expands the focus claim into an all-encompassing epistemic field.
Established writing with consequential force supplies a durable register rather than evanescent awareness.
Ease after difficulty removes any imagined obstacle to comprehensively retaining and judging the field of deeds.

structural_cues: 22:70 follows the judgment statement and repeats تَعْلَمْ and يَعْلَمُ before introducing كِتَٰبٍ.
The demonstrative إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ is repeated for the book and for divine ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies all-encompassing knowledge followed by a consequential writing; I infer that the focus deeds participate in that register. A live alternative is that the book records cosmic decree generally and is not specifically an action ledger.

changed_reading.before: Allah internally knows acts that otherwise disappear once performed.
changed_reading.after: The disputants' acts remain differentiable and registerable within an ordered field, so the reply points toward an audit trail rather than a contest of assertions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement describes worship enacted without descending authority and without knowledge. That makes the focus object 'what you do' an evidentiary commitment: conduct embodies a claim and can be tested for warrant even when the addressee does not litigate it verbally.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the enacted commitment that can carry or lack warrant.
Compelling proof supplies the absent authority against which the enacted worship is implicitly audited.
The stated absence of disclosure-backed knowledge identifies the practice's second missing warrant.

structural_cues: 22:71 moves from the knowledge and book sequence to worship lacking both authority and knowledge.
The repeated وَمَا ... construction coordinates the two absent warrants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an enacted worship practice and explicitly absent proof and knowledge; I infer that conduct functions as an embodied claim subject to audit. A live alternative is that 22:71 narrows to idolatrous worship and does not generalize the focus's تعملون.

changed_reading.before: The focus criticizes only the manner of an argumentative exchange.
changed_reading.after: It places enacted commitments under an authority-and-knowledge audit while still reserving the final verdict to Allah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cord-and-tug rendering is surprising because it materializes two abstract dispute roots; it remains anchored in focus جادل and immediate-context ينازع, whose packet branches explicitly supply tight twisting and bilateral pulling. Downstream prose should present it as a kinetic analogy for interaction, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَٰدَلُوكَ is the focus condition, and the commanded فَقُلْ supplies the response that changes the exchange's mechanics.

activation_trace.role: A tightly twisted cord gives the dispute stored tension and interdependence between its strands.
Mutual pulling between two ends turns the adjacent prohibition into a release from a tensioned exchange.
One brought-forth utterance supplies the action by which the addressee ceases pulling on the other end.

changed_reading.after: They generate a tensioned, mutually sustained exchange, and the assigned sentence removes the addressee from its two-ended pull.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading knowledge as a route-marker is branch-distant from ordinary cognition, but it remains anchored in the focus علم inventory and is activated by the immediately preceding guidance and straight-path language. Downstream prose should label it a spatial secondary activation, not redefine أَعْلَمُ as 'landmark.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَعْلَمُ carries a packet branch of a distinguishing mark, while the focus formula stands at the boundary where dispute is no longer pursued.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark or landmark lets the knowledge formula function secondarily as a boundary-marker.
Gentle direction to the road supplies the spatial field in which a distinguishing marker can orient conduct.
Straightness supplies the stable route whose argumentative boundary the focus utterance marks.

changed_reading.before: Allah has more information than the disputants.
changed_reading.after: The knowledge formula also marks the limit of argumentative navigation: remain on the directed route rather than follow every verbal detour.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bearing-and-rising image is highly form-distant because it comes from the packet's secondary q-l-l mapping of focus ق و ل; it remains formally citable and is sharpened by the adjacent branch of desisting after attachment. Downstream prose must call it a mapped-root resonance only, never a translation or morphological claim about قُلْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative قُلْ is the exact focus form carrying the packet's non-dominant mapping to root_001251.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and departing activate the assigned saying as a minimal burden borne away from the contest.
Desisting after attachment supplies the contextual motion by which the speaker disengages while retaining only the commanded utterance.

changed_reading.before: Say the sentence and remain inside the exchange.
changed_reading.after: Bear only the assigned sentence, rise from the attached contest, and let the matter pass into divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Turning deeds into a trodden route is a material branch extension rather than the ordinary sense of تعملون; it remains anchored in the focus work inventory and is activated by adjacent habitual-rite and direction branches. Downstream prose should render it as an enacted-trajectory analogy, not collapse all work into literal travel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَعْمَلُونَ is the focus object of knowledge and carries a packet branch for a repeatedly used road.

activation_trace.role: A road made clear by repeated use turns deeds into a trajectory worn by practice.
Persistence on a way supplies repetition through which ritual practice becomes a formed route.
Direction, manner, and intended course supply orientation for the route made by repeated action.

changed_reading.before: Allah knows a collection of discrete acts.
changed_reading.after: Allah knows the practiced routes people are wearing into being, including the direction sustained by repeated contention or ritual.

strongest_changes: The earlier dispute-without-knowledge pattern turns ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ into an epistemic reversal rather than a generic appeal.
The immediate ritual, mutual-pulling, call, and straight-guidance sequence changes the reply from silence into a shift from reciprocal contest to directional invitation.
The following future judgment makes the answer a present transfer of jurisdiction that permits unresolved divergence without pretending it is settled by the speaker.
The knowledge-book-authority sequence makes deeds durable, auditable commitments rather than a topic secondary to verbal claims.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remains simultaneously a bounded speech act, an audit of enacted conduct, and a jurisdictional deferral. Material branches preserve additional kinetic and spatial readings: twisted contest released from bilateral pull, knowledge as a route-marker, work as a trodden course, and the secondary q-l-l resonance of bearing the assigned saying away.
remaining_uncertainties: The writing in 22:70 may register cosmic decree generally rather than the specific deeds named in 22:68.
The scope of the differentiated ritual practice in 22:67 may be narrower than the full range of what you do in 22:68.
The material and non-dominant mapped-root outliers are traceable but should remain exploratory rather than govern the primary reading.
